item.title: A Traditional Lewis Home Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour
item.description: Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour, this traditional home in Eorodale offers flexible living, sea views, and a strong sense of place at the northern edge of the Isle of Lewis, where coastal life and community remain closely connected.The post A Traditional Lewis Home Overlooking Port of Ness Harbour appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Glen Etive Weight Limit Approved to Protect Fragile Highland Road
item.description: A permanent 18 tonne vehicle weight restriction has been approved for the C1094 road in Glen Etive, with Highland councillors saying the move is essential to protect a fragile peat based route from further damage and ensure long term safety and access.The post Glen Etive Weight Limit Approved to Protect Fragile Highland Road appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Stone Urges Prime Minister to Champion Scotch Whisky in China Talks
item.description: Jamie Stone MP has urged the Prime Minister to prioritise Scotch whisky in trade talks with China following the proposed closure of the Clynelish Distillery visitor centre in Brora, warning that jobs, investment, and Highland communities depend on securing fair export opportunities.The post Stone Urges Prime Minister to Champion Scotch Whisky in China Talks appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Balliemore Cup Draw Signals Start of Another Big Shinty Summer
item.description: The draw for the Ferguson Transport and Shipping Balliemore Cup has taken place, marking five years of sponsorship and setting up another competitive shinty season, with clubs from across Scotland preparing for a summer of knockout action leading to the final in Spean Bridge. The post Balliemore Cup Draw Signals Start of Another Big Shinty Summer appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Himalayan 450 Delivers Hard Proof in One of Britain’s Toughest Off Road Races
item.description: The Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 secured a class victory at the Valleys X Treme Lite 2026 in Wales, delivering hard evidence of its off road capability with a largely standard bike succeeding in one of the UK’s toughest endurance races.The post Himalayan 450 Delivers Hard Proof in One of Britain’s Toughest Off Road Races appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Lochaber Moves Forward With Major Investment, Planning and Community Collaboration
item.description: Lochaber is moving forward with new community funding, long term planning through FW2040, and growing collaboration across Fort William and the wider area, as councillors back regeneration projects, transport improvements, and community led development shaping the region’s future.The post Lochaber Moves Forward With Major Investment, Planning and Community Collaboration appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: BBC Debate Night Comes to Fort William as Audience Call Goes Out
item.description: BBC Scotland’s Debate Night is coming to Fort William on 11 February, with local people invited to apply for free studio tickets and take part in the live audience of the national political discussion programme.The post BBC Debate Night Comes to Fort William as Audience Call Goes Out appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Refined Period Home in The Heart of Nairn
item.description: This refined period home in the heart of Nairn offers generous proportions, high ceilings, and secure parking within a Category B listed building, placing town centre living, coastal walks, and everyday amenities within easy reach.The post A Refined Period Home in The Heart of Nairn appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Open Air, Open Mind Encourages Scots to Find Calm Outdoors This Breathing Space Day
item.description: Breathing Space Day on 1 February is encouraging people across Scotland to find calm outdoors, with NHS 24 highlighting how simple time in nature can support mental wellbeing alongside free, confidential listening support for those who need it.The post Open Air, Open Mind Encourages Scots to Find Calm Outdoors This Breathing Space Day appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Culture Funding Delivers Real Value for Scotland
item.description: Gaelic singer and SNP candidate Eilidh Munro has welcomed increased Scottish Government funding for culture and Gaelic, saying the investment delivers real value for communities, supports the creative sector, and is vital for sustaining Gaelic as a living language.The post Culture Funding Delivers Real Value for Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.
